findings.head: 0826d59e1e1b36bf80b82904859c64f339749820
findings.title: DOM-ready replay erases a successful optional model-link lookup
findings.trigger: Reader handler exists before DOM ready; local payload with empty model_id is buffered; successful optional lookup runs targeted link script; DOM ready then replays the older buffered payload. macOS initial push bypasses bridge readiness, making it an eligible source path.
findings.outcome: Resolved ID 123 becomes empty, link class is absent, and projectInfoReceived suppresses a new handshake. This visit loses the optional model link until reload/navigation; metadata/editor data loss is not claimed.
evidence: Widgets/WebView.cpp:1195-1198 and Utils/MacDarkMode.mm:107-114 use asynchronous native evaluation
findings.smallest_practical_fix: Update the model_id inside an existing buffered show_3mf_info payload when applying the targeted resolved ID; check nested payload shape and preserve editor/lifetime/generation/project guards. Do not replay the full payload. Scratch candidate is proposed-model-link.js.
verification_needed: Execute freshly extracted fixed reader/native script through the pre-DOM failure schedule and normal DOM-ready-first schedule.
Check clear/no buffered message, navigation, editor-open, HTTP failure, and stale project/generation paths.
Native delayed-document-load verification would establish backend timing; the deterministic reproduction does not estimate real-world frequency.
